feedback.details: The `notify()` function in shared/notifications.ts always writes \x07 to stdout. It is called at all HITL gates: spec approval (gates.ts:50), contract review (harness.ts:465), dirty tree check (git-ops.ts:200), evaluation override (sprint-attempts.ts:206), and mid-run steering (sprint-success.ts:84). Verified via `od -c` output showing \a character.

Fatal errors are caught in harness-claude/index.ts:85-94 where `notify()` is called with the error message (line 92). Verified with `od -c` that \a is emitted on fatal error (e.g., missing prompt). The bell fires regardless of --notify flag since `notify()` always writes \x07.

CLI accepts --notify via parseArgs (config.ts:145). Defaults to false (line 184). resolveConfig sets `notify: cli.notify || false` (line 347). Tests in sprint4.test.ts verify parsing and config resolution (lines 23-44). All pass.

When notify is true, sendDesktopNotification is invoked (notifications.ts:28). Platform detection handles 'linux' (notify-send) and 'darwin' (osascript). The test at notifications.test.ts:36-39 verifies no throw with notify:true, but doesn't mock exec to verify the subprocess is actually spawned with correct args. Code is correct but test coverage could be stronger.

When sendDesktop is false (the default), the `if (sendDesktop)` guard at notifications.ts:27 prevents sendDesktopNotification from being called. Only the terminal bell is emitted. Code is clear and correct. Test at notifications.test.ts:26-29 confirms bell fires with notify:false.

Both --commit-adhd and --commit-adhd-logs are defined in parseArgs (config.ts:146-147). Parsed correctly into commitAdhd and commitAdhdLogs booleans (lines 185-186). ResolvedConfig includes both as required booleans (types.ts:83-84). Tests in sprint4.test.ts verify parsing (lines 48-68) and config resolution (lines 70-102). All pass.

commitAdhdMetadata in git-ops.ts:59-93 stages .adhd/contracts/, .adhd/feedback/, .adhd/progress.json, and .adhd/spec.md, then commits with message '[adhd] Sprint N: contract + metadata'. Called from sprint-success.ts:48-49 when config.commitAdhd is true. Tests in commit-adhd.test.ts verify the commit message format and file staging. All pass.

When includeLogs is true, commitAdhdMetadata adds '.adhd/logs/' to pathsToStage (git-ops.ts:71-73). Test commit-adhd.test.ts:50-63 verifies logs are included in the commit when includeLogs=true. Passes.

resolveConfig sets `commitAdhd: cli.commitAdhd || cli.commitAdhdLogs || false` (config.ts:348). When --commit-adhd-logs is provided without --commit-adhd, commitAdhd is true. Test in sprint4.test.ts:91-95 verifies this implication. Passes.

When neither flag is set, commitAdhd defaults to false (config.ts:348). The `if (config.commitAdhd)` guard in sprint-success.ts:48 prevents commitAdhdMetadata from being called. Test sprint4.test.ts:97-101 verifies defaults. Passes.

The `notify()` function in shared/notifications.ts is a single reusable function exported and imported by all HITL gate sites (gates.ts, git-ops.ts, harness.ts, sprint-success.ts, sprint-attempts.ts, index.ts). No inline duplication of bell/notification logic exists.

sendDesktopNotification uses process.platform to detect 'linux' and 'darwin' (notifications.ts:40-44). Unsupported platforms get a logDebug warning and return (no-op). Subprocess failures are caught in the exec callback and logged as debug (line 51-53), never thrown. Clean implementation.

commitAdhdMetadata uses execSync directly for git commands, consistent with the pattern used throughout git-ops.ts (commitAdhdArtifacts, revertToCheckpoint, checkDirtyTree). Function name is descriptive. Minor note: the unused `gitExec` wrapper function at line 12 is flagged by the linter as unused — it exists but nothing uses it, creating slight inconsistency. The function itself doesn't use this wrapper either.

Verified: `bun run harness-claude/index.ts --help` shows all three new flags (--notify, --commit-adhd, --commit-adhd-logs) with descriptions. Running with all flags (`--notify --commit-adhd --commit-adhd-logs`) exits cleanly with expected 'prompt required' error. No runtime errors.
sprint-count.ts uses `/^##\s*Sprint\s+\d+/gim` — `^` anchor with `m` (multiline) flag. Correct.
Tests in sprint-count.test.ts verify inline prose and blockquoted headings are not counted. All 10 tests pass.
Tests verify correct counting of standard sprint headings. All pass.
Verified in conversation-logger tests and logger tests. All pass.
Conversation logger creates unique timestamped filenames. Tests pass.
Contract negotiation uses timestamped log filenames. Tests pass.
All agent types use fileTimestamp() for log names. Tests pass.
Logger supports TZ_DISPLAY config. Tests pass.
Span names use fileTimestamp() prefix matching log filenames. Tests pass.
sprint-count.test.ts has comprehensive tests for standard headings, inline prose, blockquotes. All 10 tests pass.
harness.ts:421-432 loads existing contract on resume. Tests in resume-contract-skip.test.ts pass.
When loadExistingContract returns undefined, negotiation proceeds (harness.ts:434-462). Tests pass.
Log message at harness.ts:428-430 includes sprint number and criteria count. Tests pass.
Contract validation exists in loadExistingContract. Tests in resume-contract-skip.test.ts pass.
Tests in contract-parse-error.test.ts verify diagnostic file creation. All pass.
Truncated preview logged on parse failure. Tests pass.
No diagnostic file on successful parse. Tests pass.
Directory creation on demand. Tests pass.
Truncation at reasonable length with indicator. Tests verify capping. Pass.

commitAdhdArtifacts called at sprint-attempts.ts:40 before generator invocation. Tests in git-ops.test.ts pass individually (3 failures when running all tests are due to test isolation issues, not code bugs).
Commit message uses '[adhd] Sprint N: artifacts' format (git-ops.ts:39). Tests verify.
After commitAdhdArtifacts, git status --porcelain shows no .adhd/ output. Test at git-ops.test.ts:91-102 passes.
revertToCheckpoint uses `git reset --hard` (git-ops.ts:168). No `git revert` in the codebase. Test passes when run individually but fails in full suite due to test isolation. Code is correct.
Stash/unstash pattern in git-ops.ts:99-143 preserves .adhd/ files across reset. Test at git-ops.test.ts:148+ passes individually.
Errors in stash (git-ops.ts:121-124) and unstash (git-ops.ts:134-143) are caught, logged, and don't halt execution. Unstash failure attempts conflict resolution as fallback.
HarnessProgress status union includes 'documenting' (types.ts:122). TypeScript compiles successfully.
harness.ts:551 sets status to 'documenting' before runDocumenterPhase. Tests in documenting-status.test.ts pass.
harness.ts:565 sets status to 'complete' after documenter. Tests pass.
revertToCheckpoint is called from resumeHarness (harness.ts:274). The reset-based implementation works with the existing callers. Tests pass individually.
commitAdhdArtifacts checks staged diff before committing (git-ops.ts:33-37). Test at git-ops.test.ts:81-89 verifies no empty commit is created. Passes.

overallSummary: Sprint 4 is well-implemented. The notification system uses a clean, reusable `notify()` function with proper platform detection and graceful error handling. The --commit-adhd and --commit-adhd-logs flags are correctly parsed with proper implication logic. The commitAdhdMetadata function follows existing git patterns and includes correct file staging. All dedicated tests pass (524/527, with 3 failures being test isolation issues in git-ops when run in full suite, not code bugs). The app starts cleanly with new flags and --help documents them. Minor issues: an unused `gitExec` function flagged by lint, and some formatting warnings.
